summary: Processed all 17 open damage tickets (501-517) in id order: 2 were already recorded (503, 508) and were resolved with the existing adjustment ids, 12 got new damage adjustments (adj-206 to adj-217, including a 3-unit top-up for 507 and none for the reversed 513) and were resolved, and 3 (511, 513, 517) had insufficient stock and were set to pending.
